name: Auto Deco
description: Automatically decorates your level with customizable deco styles.

style.name: Deco Style
style.description: Border: thin edges on exposed block sides. Corners: small squares on exposed corners. Scatter: random bits floating near blocks. Spikes: small thorn-like pieces on top edges.

density.name: Density
density.description: Chance (0-1) that each possible deco piece is placed.

scatter-radius.name: Scatter Radius (blocks)
scatter-radius.description: How far from blocks scatter pieces may appear.

color-id.name: Color Channel
color-id.description: Color channel ID used for deco objects.

include-hazards.name: Decorate Hazards
include-hazards.description: Also add deco around spikes and saws.
